name: Excelsior Cafe Ginza Chuo-dori
nameJa: エクセルシオールカフェ 銀座中央通り店
description: A spacious two-floor Excelsior branch on Ginza's main street with high ceilings, free Wi-Fi, and outlets at many seats that suit a long work session.

name: Starbucks Coffee CIRCLES Ginza
nameJa: スターバックスコーヒー 銀座サークルズ店
description: This Ginza Starbucks offers free Wi-Fi plus free private booths and a separate paid Think Lab focus-work area, making it flexible for remote work.

name: Starbucks Coffee Ginza Five
nameJa: スターバックスコーヒー 銀座ファイブ店
address: Ginza 5-1 GINZA FIVE B1F, Chuo-ku, Tokyo
description: A quieter basement-level Starbucks with free Wi-Fi and power outlets at select seats, reported as calmer and more work-friendly than street-level branches.

name: METoA Cafe & Kitchen
address: Ginza 5-2-1 Tokyu Plaza Ginza METoA 1F, Chuo-ku, Tokyo
description: A cafe inside Tokyu Plaza Ginza where the counter seats are each fitted with outlets and free Wi-Fi is available, useful for a short work stop while shopping.

name: Ginza Book Cafe
description: A calm book-lined cafe where every seat reportedly has a power outlet and free Wi-Fi, with browsable library shelves that make it good for extended focused work.

name: SUZU CAFE Ginza
description: A bright lounge-style cafe with large windows and free Wi-Fi but no reported power outlets, so it suits light laptop use rather than all-day work.

name: Excelsior Cafe Nihonbashi 1-chome
nameJa: エクセルシオールカフェ 日本橋一丁目店
address: Nihonbashi 1-2-6 Kuroeya Kokubu Bldg 1F, Chuo-ku, Tokyo
description: A large 84-seat Excelsior a couple of minutes from Nihonbashi Station with free Wi-Fi and outlets at counter and table seats, opening early for morning work.

name: Ueshima Coffee COREDO Nihonbashi
nameJa: 上島珈琲店 COREDO日本橋店
address: Nihonbashi 1-4-1 COREDO Nihonbashi B1F, Chuo-ku, Tokyo
description: A bright glass-walled Ueshima Coffee inside COREDO Nihonbashi offering free Wi-Fi and outlets at the counter and some tables, convenient right by the station.

name: Tully's Coffee OEDO Nihonbashi
nameJa: タリーズコーヒー OEDO日本橋店
address: Nihonbashi 2-7-1 Tokyo Nihonbashi Tower B1F, Chuo-ku, Tokyo
description: A Tully's in the base of Tokyo Nihonbashi Tower with free Wi-Fi and a large central communal table that has outlets, good for laptop work.

name: Cafe Salvador
nameJa: カフェ サルヴァドル
address: Nihonbashi-Kayabacho 1-5-8 Tokyo Shoken Kaikan 1F, Chuo-ku, Tokyo
description: A business-salon-style cafe directly connected to Kayabacho Station with free Wi-Fi, outlets at window counters and large tables, and library access for working.

name: The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf Nihonbashi 1-chome
nameJa: コーヒービーン＆ティーリーフ 日本橋一丁目店
address: Nihonbashi 1-3-13 Tokyo Tatemono Nihonbashi Bldg 1F, Chuo-ku, Tokyo
description: A spacious 50-seat Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf beside Nihonbashi Station with public Wi-Fi and outlets at counter and large-table seating.

name: DAWN ver.beta Avatar Robot Cafe
nameJa: 分身ロボットカフェ DAWN ver.β
address: Nihonbashi-Honcho 3-8-3 Nihonbashi Life Science Bldg 3, 1F, Chuo-ku, Tokyo
description: A barrier-free concept cafe staffed by remotely operated OriHime robots that also offers free Wi-Fi and outlets at some of its 70 seats for casual work.

name: Excelsior Cafe Kyobashi 1-chome
nameJa: エクセルシオールカフェ 京橋一丁目店
address: Kyobashi 1-3-5 Mitsui Garden Hotel 1F, Chuo-ku, Tokyo
description: An Excelsior on the ground floor of the Mitsui Garden Hotel near Kyobashi Station, confirmed to offer free Wi-Fi and power outlets with a fully separated smoking area.

name: Starbucks Coffee Tsukiji-ekimae
nameJa: スターバックスコーヒー 築地駅前店
description: A Starbucks a minute from Tsukiji Station Exit 2 with the chain's standard free Wi-Fi, though power-outlet availability at this branch is not documented.

name: Doutor Coffee Hatchobori
nameJa: ドトールコーヒーショップ 八丁堀店
description: A compact Doutor near Hatchobori Station that officially lists free Wi-Fi but no power outlets, fine for quick tasks rather than long laptop sessions.
